Changelog:
v1.0.4.16 - Hold-to-Repeat is now properly event-driven: subscribes to ActionWatching.OnActionSend and uses the game itself as the held-button oracle. When the user releases the hotbar, the tracker goes stale within 350ms and the plugin stops re-firing. Replaces the v1.0.4.15 time-based proxy which was unreliable in practice.

Also rolled up from v1.0.4.15:
- Install/update failure repaired (csproj Version was stuck at 1.0.4.12 while pluginmaster.json advertised 1.0.4.14, causing Dalamud to reject the install with a manifest mismatch and silently uninstall the plugin on attempted update).
- AutoDuty IPC integration actually wired up. The v1.0.4.13 implementation subscribed to AutoDuty.isRunning / AutoDuty.isPaused / AutoDuty.currentState - none of which AutoDuty exports. Rewritten to use the real PascalCase IPC surface (AutoDuty.IsStopped, AutoDuty.IsNavigating). Gluttony now properly yields rotation and targeting whenever AutoDuty has the wheel (Pyretic, untarget, navigation).
- Hold-to-Repeat compile-time errors fixed (missing FFXIVClientStructs imports + unsafe block wrap; the v1.0.4.14 binary that shipped was actually a pre-A0 build because the source didn't compile).
